sources.entry: BTCPay Server - Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies payment processor. (Demo, Source Code) MIT C#

summary.one_liner: BTCPay Server is a free, open-source, self-hosted payment processor that lets merchants accept Bitcoin directly without fees or intermediaries.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes BTCPay Server as a free and open-source, self-hosted Bitcoin payment processor for merchants. It states that merchants can accept Bitcoin directly without fees or intermediaries. The README is short and mainly organizes links by audience (users, operators, developers, maintainers) and points to a documentation gateway, website, Greenfield API, demo, issue tracker, discussions, and community chat. It does not detail specific features in this text. The awesome-selfhosted listing also mentions support for other cryptocurrencies.
use_cases: accept bitcoin payments on a website
run a private bitcoin payment server
develop plugins for a payment processor
notable: Self-hosted, so merchants run their own payment processor with no intermediary
No fees charged by the processor itself, per the README
Has a Greenfield API for integrations
Documentation organized by audience: users, operators, developers, maintainers
Listed as supporting Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies (per awesome-selfhosted listing)
caveats: README gives little detail on installation or features; relies on external documentation
Security issues must go through SECURITY.md rather than public issues
keywords: crypto payment alternative to payment processors
